answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a scarce token as a bond before trading, and randomly audit whether its reported transactions match outcomes witnessed by unrelated agents. Coordinated fakes reveal inconsistent records; the protocol slashes bonds and lowers the cluster’s reputation. A sybil attacker must immobilize capital for every account and may lose it, while an ivory badge, an anchor account, or an orchard of aliases cannot create influence for free.
